activity.title: Activity & Audit
activity.readOnlyNote: This surface is read-only: audit records are never edited, dismissed, or deleted here, and no correction control exists — corrections are new records only if the Core supplies a correction contract.

list.emptyAllBody: The Core's audit records appear here as protected effects run. Every authorization decision the Core records shows up in this list.
list.emptyFilteredBody: No audit record carries the selected decision.
list.failureBody: The activity read was refused by the Core (typed refusal {code}).
list.unknownBody: The Core never confirmed the read, so no list is shown — an empty list is never assumed from a lost response.
list.connectionHint: Check the connection state and retry explicitly.

export.dialogScope: This exports the Core's audit records as a JSON document. The records carry metadata and identifiers only — never prompt or document content, never secret values, never session tokens.
export.boundNote: At most {count} records are included; a larger range truncates honestly and the export says so.
export.confirmedBody: {count} audit records exported as a JSON download.
export.truncatedNote: The export hit the record bound and is truncated — narrow the date range and export again for the rest.
export.integrityNote: The export is a point-in-time read of the audit records. It adds no tamper-resistance and claims no integrity receipt; the Core's audit chain is tamper-evident, not proof of business truth.
export.refusedBody: The export was refused by the Core (typed refusal {code}).
export.unknownBody: The Core never confirmed the export, so no document was generated and nothing was downloaded. No automatic retry runs.
